title: Lily’s Jungle Adventure
moral: Kindness and courage can help others and bring happiness.

scenes.summary: Lily finds a map and enters a mysterious jungle.
scenes.text: Lily found an old map and entered a jungle filled with tall trees and strange sounds.
scenes.image_prompt: little girl holding map entering jungle with tall trees and birds, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Lily hears a cry and finds a trapped monkey.
scenes.text: She heard a cry and found a baby monkey trapped in a thorny bush.
scenes.image_prompt: girl helping baby monkey stuck in bush, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: They travel to an enchanted forest and meet friends.
scenes.text: With the monkey, she entered an enchanted forest and met a wise owl and other animals.
scenes.image_prompt: girl monkey owl in magical forest with glowing lights, cheerful cartoon

scenes.summary: They rescue a squirrel from goblins.
scenes.text: They followed clues and rescued a squirrel from goblins using teamwork.
scenes.image_prompt: girl and animals saving squirrel from goblins, fantasy cartoon

scenes.summary: Lily returns home as a hero.
scenes.text: Lily returned home happily, remembering her brave adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: girl returning home smiling after adventure, warm cartoon

story: Lily found an old map and entered a mysterious jungle full of tall trees and sounds. She heard a cry and helped a baby monkey stuck in a bush. Together they entered an enchanted forest and met a wise owl. They worked together to rescue a squirrel from goblins. Lily returned home happy and proud of her adventure.
